champion.tips: KAYLE TIPS AND TRICKS Kayle is a weak early game champion until she gets her Ultimate R as it provides her with range and increased survivability. Play safe until you’ve unlocked your Ultimate R . Whenever your Ultimate R is on cooldown, you should play a little safer as you’re rather squishy and can easily die if you’re caught without your Ultimate R to protect you. In the early game, keep the wave closer to your side of the map to increase your survivability and reduce the enemies ability to set you behind.
champion.builds: THE BEST KAYLE BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR MID IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Kayle Mid build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Press the Attack as your keystone, followed by Absorb Life, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Celerity and Gathering Storm in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Nashor's Tooth as your first item, followed by Boots of Swiftness and Rabadon's Deathcap. For your last 3 items, you should build Lich Bane, Shadowflame and finish with Void Staff. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 55.4% winrate over 10 875 matches played. Optional Your second option for Kayle Mid build would be to take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Lethal Tempo as your keystone, Absorb Life, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Celerity with Gathering Storm in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Nashor's Tooth, which you should build first, followed by Boots of Swiftness as your second item and Rabadon's Deathcap as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Shadowflame, Lich Bane and Zhonya's Hourglass. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 51.9% win rate over 480 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Fleet Footwork as your keystone, Absorb Life, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Celerity with Gathering Storm in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Nashor's Tooth as your first item, then Boots of Swiftness as a second item and Rabadon's Deathcap as a third item. You want to finish the build with Lich Bane, Shadowflame and Zhonya's Hourglass. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it E - Q - W. This build is currently sitting at a 55.9% win rate across 467 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Kayle Mid build in the current patch, try Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, Lethal Tempo, Absorb Life, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand as your primary rune tree, and Celerity with Gathering Storm as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Guinsoo's Rageblade as your first item, then finish Boots of Swiftness as your second item, and Nashor's Tooth as third item. The last 3 options are Rabadon's Deathcap, Shadowflame and Lich Bane. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 50.0% win rate over 78 matches played. Situational Kayle Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Kayle build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Kayle runes page.
